messages:
sam: Heads up — the golden stapler from the front desk went missing this morning. Anyone seen it? :eyes:
alia: Wait, the one with the tiny sticker of a narwhal?
kevin: OMG that narwhal-stapler is legendary. last seen during All Hands when Ryan used it to press 'next slide' :joy:
ryan: not my fault the staple jam made me heroic
jen: who would take a stapler tho
sam: i mean it's a trophy at this point. someone is clearly building an office shrine
staple-bot: New poll: Who is the Golden Stapler Thief? Options: Ryan, Kevin, Alia, Unknown Office Goblin — Vote with :one: :two: :three: :four:
alia: :three: but i'm innocent
kevin: :two: — false accusation accepted
ryan: :one: fine. guilty of misuse of stationery rights
maria (People Ops): if it has glitter on it i will be concerned. also pls return it before checkpoint ok
sam: low-key suspecting the 'Supply Closet Shadow' again. started hearing jingles near the copy room at 9am
jen: we should start a ledger. mandatory label: 'Do not steal the golden stapler'
alia: Proposal: the next person who borrows it has to bring donuts. immediate enforcement.
ryan: agreed. Staplebandit gets donuts plus public confession :laughing:
sam: anyone wanna volunteer to be the 'Stapler Sheriff' this week? i'll take midnight rounds :sunglasses:
maria (People Ops): do we need a formal policy? can we call it Equipment Etiquette 101? :notebook_with_decorative_cover:
kevin: whoever finds it gets to name it. voting options: 'Earl', 'Staplius', 'Stappy' — more suggestions welcome
jen: 'Staplius' is my vote
sam: Found it! (drumroll) it's under the cactus by the window. mystery solved. no glitter. no narwhal sticker. :detective:
ryan: output: 'case closed' :trophy:
alia: sweet. cake for the Stapler Sheriff!
staple-bot: Poll closed. Winner: Unknown Office Goblin :robot_face:
maria (People Ops): ok but officially please put a signed sticky note next time. or we will implement donut tax :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
sam: noted. returning to its rightful altar now. thanks team :heart:
